verdict: NO-GO as the two branches stand, with no Blocking finding: both trees pass `go run ./tools/ci all` (exit 0 in spec-req at 8cc30a8 and in replan at b2c79fd) and the names gate (CLEAN, 0 hits, both), the diffs hold no U+2014, every requirement id a task cites is live (1202 ids, 0 unknown, 0 duplicates, 0 reading aids pointing at the wrong section), all 138 task files parse with the ten front-matter fields, every needs/after names a live task with no cycle, and every count docs/plan.md keeps is true by the command it names (37 merges from eedda13, 11 on docs/plan.md, 10 on fast.go, 2984 lines, 103 earlier tasks, 16 surfaces, 18 new tasks). What stops the GO is a set of Required items: (1) `reqs allocate` writes earlier pages before it refuses a later one while saying "nothing was written" (reproduced); (2) six `owns` overlaps that no needs/after edge orders, which `tools/ci plan` will fail the day it lands, two of them on this very pair of branches (T104 claims the reqs files it never edits; T121 and T122 edit files outside their owns, one on the `ask-first` surface the forecast lacks); (3) one contradiction inside 12 12.11 (the decision tables of 06 6.1 and 02 2.6 carry nine ids the rule says they carry none of); (4) three contradictions inside docs/plan.md (duplicated list numbers; the M2 row versus the sitting M2 bullet; the four foundation packages that "need nothing of M0" while two of them do); (5) a lens that quotes the criterion this same diff replaced. Each fix is a few lines; none changes the design.

skill_steps_skipped: every install a skill names (gopls, gotests, golangci-lint, govulncheck, gosec, `claude mcp add gopls`) was skipped; nothing was installed and no config was edited
